# Bronze tables

<!-- Generated by `make docs-tables` from the schemas in analytics/pipelines/src/pipelines/schemas/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Bronze holds one typed Iceberg table per source table, with one row per change event, and a quarantine table per source table for the records that fail validation. **Type** is the Spark SQL type. **Nullable** `no` means the pipeline always writes a value; Iceberg itself declares every lake column nullable.

## bronze.customers

Customers who place orders. Change log of source table customers: one typed row per Debezium change event (create, update, delete or snapshot), append-only and not deduplicated

Partitioned by day of `_published_at`.

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `customer_id` | bigint | no | Customer identifier, the source table's primary key |
| `customer_name` | string | no | Name of the customer |
| `is_active` | boolean | no | Whether the customer is active |
| `customer_address` | string | yes | Address of the customer |
| `updated_at` | timestamp | yes | Time the source row was last updated (source wall clock read as UTC) |
| `updated_by` | bigint | yes | Identifier of the user who last updated the source row |
| `created_at` | timestamp | yes | Time the source row was created (source wall clock read as UTC) |
| `created_by` | bigint | yes | Identifier of the user who created the source row |
| `_record_source` | string | no | Kafka topic the change event was read from |
| `_source_partition` | int | no | Kafka partition of the record |
| `_source_offset` | bigint | no | Offset of the record in its Kafka partition |
| `_published_at` | timestamp | no | Kafka record timestamp (UTC); the table is partitioned by its day |
| `_change_op` | string | no | Kind of change: create, update, delete or snapshot (Debezium op c, u, d or r) |
| `_commit_sequence` | bigint | no | Position of the change in the source's commit log (Debezium source.lsn); increases in commit order |
| `_changed_at` | timestamp | no | Time the change was committed in the source database (Debezium source.ts_ms) |
| `_captured_at` | timestamp | no | Time Debezium processed the change (envelope ts_ms) |
| `_content_hash` | string | no | Hex SHA-256 of the content columns (key and audit columns excluded); unchanged content keeps its hash |

## bronze.customers_quarantine

Change events of source table customers that failed bronze validation, kept raw with the reason

Partitioned by day of `_published_at`.

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `_record_source` | string | no | Kafka topic the change event was read from |
| `_source_partition` | int | no | Kafka partition of the record |
| `_source_offset` | bigint | no | Offset of the record in its Kafka partition |
| `_published_at` | timestamp | no | Kafka record timestamp (UTC); the table is partitioned by its day |
| `_landing_file` | string | no | Path of the landing Avro file the record was read from |
| `key` | string | yes | Raw Kafka record key, as text |
| `value` | string | no | Raw Kafka record value, as text |
| `_failure_reason` | string | no | First validation check the record failed |
| `_quarantined_at` | timestamp | no | Processing time of the micro-batch that quarantined the record |
